blurb: Rockport Harbor Marina is located at 911 Navigation Circle in Rockport, Texas. It is a local landmark filled with various boats and bait shops, within walking distance of downtown Rockport and other attractions. The harbor hosts shrimping boats, sailing boats, cruising yachts, local bait shops, and a guided birdwatching tour operation.
